scope: Independent bounded closure audit of current AGENTS T00-T14; no new benchmark design, model calls, environment changes, or historical score edits. Evidence summaries checked against named structured audits; this is not a new rereading of every underlying trajectory.

authorization_snapshot.interpretation: Original additional200 includes failures, total268. This is a snapshot; root may start concurrent authorized work. No new quota approval needed merely because work is materials rather than judge. Model/scope changes and formal launch remain separate decisions.

decision.must_not_mark_goal_complete: Software tests and local reviewed cases do not establish full dataset/formal evaluation. Root owns actual goal state; this subagent does not change it.
decision.not_all_work_blocked: Environment and pending material strategy block their specific branches, not finite existing-input judge development, source/metadata audits or offline integration.
decision.no_blanket_invalidation: Formal role-isolation limitations limit claims and future admission; they do not erase actual observed controlled-container behavior, known solver errors or manually reviewed judge evidence.

requirements.does_not_prove: Not native host-tool isolation, arbitrary-kernel safety, or cross-host numerical equivalence. Earlier runtime audit gaps must be read with newer timeout/collection audits, not treated as still wholly unimplemented.
requirements.can_continue_without_new_user_decision: Yes: bounded regressions and package preflight on already-authorized local CPU Docker. No need to acquire server/GPU or prove universal cross-host behavior to close local engineering.
requirements.decision_if_needed: Only if moving host or installing/altering system environment; those are not current routine development prerequisites.

requirements.proves: Current exact-binary native selector and JSON transport were actually exercised with fixed model/medium and visible skill catalogue suppressed; schema-dict and ledger-error contracts repaired.
requirements.does_not_prove: Not bare-API equivalence or absence of all system/tool context. Tool-activity auditing does not prevent a host read that already happened.
requirements.can_continue_without_new_user_decision: Yes: retain explicit subscription-transport naming and observed context; fix finite contract/inheritance defects without claiming bare-model equivalence. Reuse existing evidence rather than repeat model probes without a new hypothesis.
requirements.decision_if_needed: U1 for OS-isolation environment; changing executor model/transport semantics beyond the established development configuration requires explicit protocol choice.

requirements.proves: Native Codex judge actively retrieves evidence and emits internal score plus same-turn public feedback. Complete observable trajectories have been read for concrete cases.
requirements.does_not_prove: Not merely a prompt-only stub, but also not universal scoring reliability or complete host sandboxing.
requirements.can_continue_without_new_user_decision: Yes: finish limited fresh-case behavior checks and byte-bound visible-tool review. Existing reviewed development judgments remain useful evidence; do not erase them because formal isolation remains pending.

requirements.proves: Five types have case-level native judge evidence. Fresh visual and EXP/WRITE_CONTENT target defects were distinguished; one correct short WRITE_CONTENT case survived a repeat/paraphrase/order diagnostic.
requirements.does_not_prove: IDEA/LIT latest-policy independent leaveout coverage is limited; EXP platform-provenance attribution and non-target grade variation remain. Local stability is not population reliability. Older completeness audit predates the newer v2.8 tests and must not overwrite them.
requirements.can_continue_without_new_user_decision: Yes: root is already preparing bounded fresh IDEA/LIT cases. Freeze configuration, prerecord observable acceptance expectations, inspect full visible trajectories and semantic feedback, report pass/partial/fail once. Do not force low scores or endlessly repair the same examples. A finite module-level development acceptance with explicit limitations is sufficient; no extra human experts or global reliability theorem required.
requirements.decision_if_needed: Only changes to primary aggregation, penalties, acceptance meaning, or model configuration—not ordinary prompt/fixture engineering—need protocol confirmation.

requirements.does_not_prove: Those two examples do not fix budgets for new papers. Old and increased-budget runs are not evolution improvements. Costs snapshot181 is historical, not current ledger.
requirements.can_continue_without_new_user_decision: Yes: each new dev package gets independently justified resource candidates and measurement. Continue cost accounting under shared remaining authorization; no new quota request needed while sufficient.
requirements.decision_if_needed: Formal package settings and run/retry accounting freeze under U3; do not silently raise already-fixed per-task experimental limits.

requirements.proves: Actual scientific artifact generation/visual delivery and controlled fulltext reading occurred; public-input byte identity and evidence hash-domain distinctions now checked.
requirements.does_not_prove: Not all future package tools work; old runs did not see later added identity/collection fields. Do not retroactively credit their judges with those checks.
requirements.can_continue_without_new_user_decision: Yes: bounded preflight for declared tools/new assets, and actual changed-code smoke as needed; avoid rerunning unchanged successful controls solely to increase test counts.
